The system is intended to tempt AI agents into attempting to escape their constraints or perform unauthorized actions, allowing researchers to evaluate real-world safety risks and the models' capability to exploit zero-day vulnerabilities.

* [Core Event] Anthropic (Researcher Darya Kaviani) (AI security testing platform): Deployed 'Siren' honeypot system to test agent jailbreak and exploit tendencies
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Assess security boundaries in autonomous workflows and model capability in discovering zero-day vulnerabilities
* [Key Technical Spec] Siren tests AI agent jailbreak intent and technical ability via temptation.
* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Focuses on predictive assessment of autonomous risk rather than just current safety.
